'''''Fatman''''' was a heavily modified [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owned and piloted by [[Zeerid Korr]]. It was most commonly used for smuggling or delivering illegal goods but was destroyed during atmospheric entry over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]] while delivering [[Engspice]].
